description: The whole of the Caper knowledge base as one text document, for bulk ingestion. Preflight first: sizeOnly=true returns the character count, a token estimate, the per-branch breakdown and the largest pages. Then pull it with `maxChars` (default 200000, max 1000000), or one branch at a time with `tagPath`. Truncation is page-aligned: `truncated`, `omittedPages` and `nextSkip` say where to resume (pass skip=nextSkip). For a handful of pages get_pages is cheaper.

sizeOnly.description: Sizes and breakdowns only, no document. Do this before the first real pull.

skip.description: Resume from this page index: the `nextSkip` of the previous truncated call (default 0)

tagPath.description: One branch and its descendants. Omit for everything.

name: get_full_corpus
title: Whole corpus
